protocol.target: 8 next M15 closes wholly within same NY RTH; anchor is latest CLOSED SPY close, including gap to next open
protocol.selection: First 50% target days initial history; next20% validation chooses lowest 8-step path MAE%; last30% untouched by this selector. No selection by final test. Original research archive already viewed: exploratory, not pristine forward validation.
protocol.source: SPY price + original-volume SPY V + Composite Strength + WLR/candle features; aeon3 excluded because different horizon
protocol.purge: same NY minute; each candidate target completed before query 16-bar input start; up to20 non-overlap analogs, one/day; prior uses all eligible same-minute days
protocol.line: pointwise median, not one most likely coherent path; P10/P90 descriptive pointwise envelope, not 80% simultaneous coverage; percent frequency not calibrated probability
protocol.criterion: Path MAE%, lower is better; FLAT is eligible and may win; bootstrap by target day (5-day blocks) vs FLAT
